items.difficulty_reason: Completed-local-ring lemma (statement 3132-3148, proof 3150-3169): the completed local ring of the pushout at the image of the attached finite subscheme is the fibre product of the completed local rings of the components - the proof reduces to an affine open, starts from the construction's ring-level fibre product diagram, and finishes in two cited tooling steps (completion preserves finite fibre products; finite-extension completion identifies the factors); the argument is complete in the span, and the situation setup is the section's shared construction referenced by the statement itself. H2: two-step completion argument.
